cameraId.title: Camera ID (pairing ID)
cameraId.description: Original camera/pairing ID from the camera's account record or app data. With the camera IP, derives stream credentials and enables video without MQTT. Use the original ID, not the hardware serial or already-hashed stream path.

rtspUsername.title: RTSP username
rtspUsername.description: Used with Camera ID to calculate the stream password. Ignored when a complete authenticated RTSP URL is supplied.

rtspUrl.title: Authenticated RTSP URL
rtspUrl.description: Optional alternative to Camera ID. Paste the complete stream URL, including its username and password. This URL takes precedence over Camera ID. Sensors, sound controls, and event recording require MQTT and are unavailable in either authenticated video mode.

ip.title: Camera IP or hostname
ip.description: Required with Camera ID or for MQTT discovery. Enter only the address or hostname, without a port or path. Optional with an authenticated RTSP URL; if supplied, it must match the URL host.

audio.title: Enable camera audio
audio.description: Listen to the camera microphone. Disable to troubleshoot a stream with unsupported or missing audio.

unbridge.title: Configure camera as an unbridged accessory
unbridge.description: This is recommended if you aren't running the plugin as a child bridge and you don't have HKSV enabled.

hksv.title: Enable HomeKit Secure Video Recording
hksv.description: Requires a working MQTT connection for camera events, a HomeKit hub, and a supported iCloud plan. Unavailable in authenticated video mode (Camera ID or RTSP URL).

enableSoundMachine.title: Expose a switch in HomeKit to play/pause the built in sound machine.
enableSoundMachine.description: Requires a working MQTT connection. Unavailable in authenticated video mode (Camera ID or RTSP URL).

contactSensors.title: Configure the sensors as Contact Sensors rather than Motion Sensors.

movementSensitivity.title: Movement Sensitivity Level
movementSensitivity.description: Select the level of movement sensitivity to trigger the movement sensor attached to the HomeKit camera.

enableCryingDetectionSensor.title: Expose a sensor for crying detection notifications.
enableCryingDetectionSensor.description: Crying Detection must be configured in the Lollipop app for this to trigger.

enableCrossingDetectionSensor.title: Expose a sensor for barrier crossing detection notifications
enableCrossingDetectionSensor.description: Crossing Detection must be configured in the Lollipop app for this to trigger.

enableNoiseSensor.title: Expose a sensor for unacceptable noise detection notifications.
enableNoiseSensor.description: Noise must be configured in the Lollipop app for this to trigger.
